prompt:
Extract every policy commitment stated in the text below.

Rules:
- One commitment per line.
- Write each as a verb phrase: an action followed by its object. For example: "raise the income tax threshold" or "build 300000 new homes".
- State each commitment at the level of a distinct policy action, not its implementation details. Do not subdivide a single commitment into steps.
- Include every commitment. Do not select, rank, prioritise, or judge importance.
- Use the text's own terms for policy objects. Do not substitute synonyms.
- Do not number the lines. No bullets, headings, preamble, or commentary.
- If the text states no policy commitments, output the single word NONE.

<text>
Liberal Democrats Manifesto 2024 — Summary (under 500 words)

Vision: A “Fair Deal” built on five themes: a stronger fairer economy; world-class public services; a clean, nature-positive UK; a cooperative, outward-looking Britain; and a truly fair democracy.

Economy and jobs
- Repair UK–EU relations (remove trade barriers now; long-term aim to join the Single Market).  
- Green-led growth: invest in renewables, home insulation, zero‑carbon transport/industry; 90% renewable electricity by 2030; net zero by 2045.  
- Cost of living: home energy upgrades, food strategy, careful fiscal policy to lower mortgages.  
- Skills and work: more apprenticeships, Lifelong Skills Grants, overhaul apprenticeship levy; flexible parental leave; modernise gig‑economy rights and sick pay; living wage review.  
- Fair taxes: windfall tax on oil/gas, reverse bank tax cuts, raise Digital Services Tax, reform capital gains; expand British Business Bank.  
- Small business/high streets: replace business rates with a Commercial Landowner Levy; tackle late payments.  
- Tech/AI: pro-innovation, cross‑sector regulation with transparency and accountability.

Climate, energy and environment
- Home energy upgrades (free for low‑income households), social energy tariff, decouple electricity prices from gas, ban fracking/new coal.  
- Community energy, grid upgrades, storage (hydrogen, batteries).  
- End sewage scandal: turn water firms into public‑benefit companies, ban bonuses, tougher regulator, real‑time discharge data, sewage tax.  
- “Double nature” by 2050; 60m trees a year; Clean Air Act; stronger environmental watchdogs.

Health and care
- Right to see a GP within 7 days (24h urgent) with 8,000 more GPs; expand Pharmacy First.  
- NHS dentistry access; mental health hubs in every community and dedicated professionals in every school; free prescriptions for chronic mental health.  
- Cancer: 100% treated within 62 days of urgent referral; more radiotherapy/cancer nurses.  
- Social care: free personal care; workforce plan; Royal College of Care Workers; Carer’s Minimum Wage (+£2/hr); paid carer’s leave and guaranteed respite.

Education and families
- Per‑pupil funding rises above inflation; rebuild unsafe schools; “Tutoring Guarantee.”  
- Early years: extra free hours for disadvantaged children; triple Early Years Pupil Premium.  
- Teacher recruitment/retention strategy; broader curriculum; better SEND funding.  
- Reinstate maintenance grants; £5,000 Lifelong Skills Grants (aim £10k).  
- Parental leave: double Statutory Maternity/Shared Parental Pay; extra paid month for fathers; day‑one rights; return to Erasmus+.

Housing and communities
- Build 380,000 homes/year including 150,000 social; 10 garden cities; brownfield first; use‑it‑or‑lose‑it permissions.  
- Renters: ban no‑fault evictions; three‑year default tenancies; national landlord register; abolish leasehold; remove cladding at no cost to leaseholders.  
- End rough sleeping; stronger powers over second homes/short‑lets.

Transport
- Accelerate EV rollout (charging, grants, 2030 ZEV sales); cut VAT on public charging.  
- Freeze rail fares; simplify tickets; major electrification; Northern Powerhouse Rail; empower bus franchising and keep £2 cap while reviewed; national active travel plan; more road maintenance.  
- Frequent-flyer‑focused taxes; super‑tax on private jets; ban short domestic flights where <2.5h rail exists.

Crime and justice
- Restore community policing; guarantee police attendance to burglaries; cut court backlogs; stronger response to VAWG; create Online Crime Agency; scrap PCCs; Hillsborough Law; rehabilitation to cut reoffending.

Immigration and asylum
- End Hostile Environment; scrap Illegal Migration Act and Rwanda plan; safe legal routes; 3‑month decision standard; right to work after 3 months; flexible work visas; protect EU citizens’ rights.

Rights and political reform
- Defend Human Rights Act; ban conversion therapy; misogyny as hate crime; digital rights; trans-inclusive reforms; flexible working right.  
- Proportional representation (STV) for MPs and councils; scrap voter ID; votes at 16; cap donations; reform Lords; written federal constitution.

Defence and international
- Increase defence spending towards 2.5% GDP; reverse Army cuts; maintain nuclear deterrent; tighter arms export controls.  
- Rebuild EU partnership via a four‑stage roadmap; back Ukraine (including using frozen Russian assets); restore 0.7% aid; support BBC World Service.  
- Israel–Gaza: immediate bilateral ceasefire; two‑state solution; recognise Palestine.  
- National Food Strategy; fund nature‑friendly farming (+£1bn/year); uphold high standards in trade.
